name: rs-scope-mcp
description: Let Claude drive a Rohde & Schwarz RTB2 / RTB2000 oscilloscope over LAN and keep what it measures.
long_description: Connects to an R&S RTB2 or RTB2000 oscilloscope over the LAN (raw SCPI, port 5025) with the complete command set: every documented command plus the undocumented commands the firmware reports, each validated before it is sent. Task tools capture analog channels, logic pods and decoded serial buses (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, LIN, parallel) in one call, run FFTs, Bode sweeps, measurements and pass/fail mask tests, and walk segmented memory. Everything is stored locally with the instrument setup, so Claude gets compact summaries and drills into samples, edges or frames only when needed. Generator outputs, Bode sweeps, resets, file deletion and network settings need explicit confirmation. Includes a demo mode. Free for hobbyists; commercial use needs a license (see COMMERCIAL.md). Independent project, not affiliated with Rohde & Schwarz.

tools.name: connection
tools.description: Connect to the scope; identity and installed options.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Acquire and harvest analog channels, logic pods and bus decodes in one call; returns a summary.

tools.name: spectrum
tools.description: FFT between two frequencies; noise floor and strongest peaks.

tools.name: bode
tools.description: Bode sweep (K36, guarded): -3 dB points, peak, response shape.

tools.name: mask
tools.description: Pass/fail tolerance masks: learn from a good signal, test, count failures.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Segmented memory: info, or harvest every segment.

tools.name: data
tools.description: Drill into stored samples, edges and decoded frames, or read-only SQL.

tools.name: session
tools.description: Group captures by task and goal.

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Show, save or restore the instrument setup.

tools.name: demo
tools.description: A looping show of what the scope can do (guarded; analog or full).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: The scope screen as an image.

tools.name: scpi
tools.description: Any SCPI command or batch, validated and error-checked; guarded where it acts outside the screen.

tools.name: scpi_search
tools.description: Find commands in the registry by keyword.

tools.name: scpi_describe
tools.description: Parameters, values, ranges, defaults and bench notes for one command.

tools.name: scpi_block
tools.description: Binary block queries (waveforms, files) saved to the data folder.

host.title: Scope address
host.description: IP address or host name of the oscilloscope (on the scope: Menu, Setup, Interface, Ethernet, Parameter).

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where captures, screenshots and the catalog are stored. The default is created on first use. To use a new folder elsewhere, create it in Finder first (this picker cannot create folders), then choose it.
